name: Funded Futures Network
status_note: Trustpilot reviews from August and September 2026 include many complaints about slow or denied payouts. Read the payout rules before buying.
instruments: CME Group futures (equity index E-mini/micro, interest rates, FX, Micro Bitcoin, livestock, grains, energy, metals); products outside the listed table require contacting support

programs.name: MAX Standard
programs.consistency_rule: 40% in evaluation and sim funded; none on live

news_trading: Restricted: allowed in evaluations; in exhibition, sim-funded and live-funded accounts traders must be flat (no positions or pending orders) from 1 minute before to 1 minute after Tier 1 US events (CPI, FOMC, NFP, GDP); violation = immediate liquidation and forfeited profits
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: no explicit ban found, but the HFT rule applies to manual and automated trading: no more than 30% of a session's trades may last 5 seconds or less; one violation fails the account and forfeits profits with no appeal
copy_trading: Allowed with limits: max 5 copy-traded accounts at once (max 10 accounts total per user); exceeding 5 makes all copy-traded accounts lose funding eligibility
overnight_weekend_holding: Not allowed: day-trade only; flat with no pending orders by 4:50 PM ET Monday-Friday (auto-close at 4:50 PM ET, not on early-close holidays).
restricted_countries_note: 23 prohibited countries incl. Russia, Ukraine, Azerbaijan, Pakistan, Nigeria, Iran, Iraq, Venezuela, Cuba, North Korea. https://fundedfuturesnetwork.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47386113405083-Article-12-1-Country-Restrictions-Product-List
path_to_live: After 5 consecutive payouts on an account the trader can apply to their risk manager (final decision is the risk manager's). Live accounts: 90/10 split, no consistency rule, no maximum payout, same-day payouts. For accounts bought after 2026-07-01 sim-funded profits are forfeited and live starts at account size plus original buffer.

current_public_promo.discount: 50% off plus a free second account (buy 1 get 1)
current_public_promo.applies_to: STEADY evaluations, new purchases; free account must be claimed within 45 days; no end date shown

affiliate_program.notes: Help center has no affiliate information; main site could not be read. A secondary tracker mentions an affiliate email, but no official affiliate page was confirmed.
